**Albert Einstein** was a German-born theoretical physicist widely regarded as one of the greatest scientists in history. He revolutionized our understanding of space, time, gravity, light, and energy.

## Quick facts

| Detail | Information |
|--------|--------|
| Born | March 14, 1879 |
| Birthplace | Ulm, Germany |
| Died | April 18, 1955 |
| Age | 76 |
| Profession | Theoretical physicist |
| Nobel Prize | Physics, 1921 |
| Famous equation | E = mc² |


## His greatest discoveries

![E = mc² (1905 original Einstein handwriting) | Einstein, California institute of technology, Albert einstein](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/exB4lpso70w3_Re7oiQ84sEyl2kkmAXZDje8ogZCmyaZVq-2utCVZ7j31M7NvB-KQDmq8-VXMl2fnZZy-VsQhPDxB1n-anFNSrAeIJyMSucF5tYADlKMhHNFAv_AJsdVZjxryPf_qIVpTXwPuyzcFA1cxtbwupfrw5o-KjbHg1I-oMasegB1bxaHlT8cjATt?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Mass-energy equivalence**

His famous equation\:

\[
E=mc^2
\]

It shows that mass and energy are interchangeable.

---

![general relativity - When spacetime is being curved, Does that mean it is moving? - Physics Stack Exchange](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/BIDOvutl9zR1xu2DrVr0M7pEReMd7CEw8dU-GlmKRE_yTAO0GjimXWOQq9nOxEuHhr6_1JI93IDc8ehslXJ7cDXcn5YHeMtyausFn-Wyrs1QOS0pj6huFPVCqCei-mRLJ_LD2R11O7PY1Ae_JW_Bs1pHOMEvjQZNONb7In4we-G-RoKkBW0R4YgJh1UUrfuh?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. General relativity (1915)**

Explained gravity as the curvature of space and time caused by mass and energy.

---

![PPT - MODERN PHYSICS PowerPoint Presentation, free download - ID:5107044](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/KglVd4YB1eVaxcTTnYJVsOHk2PDJBPccLR6wXy3nLQXjR3v7RQH7kWA4VT5_PdgcguJAiWBLqBe7IE3mOIloMRpaURWcnjqhYZVPriuX5DOSCfsaJlulXSUnyLgCYypHRbofcEekW-ZnzyLuiuKyiVqXolR9XMN4DSVni43g_UA1q4GseOW2Pr2nTrIc_OWr?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Photoelectric effect**

Explained how light can release electrons from materials. This work earned him the Nobel Prize.

---

![PPT - Exploring Relativity and Quantum Mechanics: A Comprehensive Lecture Series PowerPoint Presentation - ID:2225862](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/QCRO6EzaoXVArQQ0UwczAwZRipnwDhjvNjX-recVd5NO4l25_JBuaa0ddr9x303CeoBAaacgoXLrSjKSXeQgeHtcKTq9L8fGYes3-k8j4R8OxC-5uDCgX-zso2WEnqbgmrxiZK5hleYBq7qouEjnDzaDISW4Er5smGqleWy6bQgoPwTaXdwcI1hftBifJWPV?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Special relativity (1905)**

Demonstrated that space and time depend on the observer's motion, while the speed of light in a vacuum is constant.

## His life timeline

- **1879\:** Born in Germany.
- **1896\:** Began studying mathematics and physics in Switzerland.
- **1905\:** Published groundbreaking scientific papers, known as his miracle year.
- **1915\:** Presented general relativity.
- **1921\:** Awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics.
- **1933\:** Emigrated to the United States.
- **1955\:** Died in Princeton, New Jersey.

## His life timeline

- **1879\:** Born in Germany.
- **1896\:** Began studying mathematics and physics in Switzerland.
- **1905\:** Published groundbreaking scientific papers, known as his miracle year.
- **1915\:** Presented general relativity.
- **1921\:** Awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics.
- **1933\:** Emigrated to the United States.
- **1955\:** Died in Princeton, New Jersey.
